name: 犬用双面加绒保暖睡垫款

shots.intent: 首屏用宠物在垫子上熟睡的真实居家晨光承接点击，一秒传达厚实柔软、铺开就是它的一大块睡区

shots.intent: 把四条材质主张压成一行线性图标加卷装实物，替掉源图堆叠的形容词口号，让卖点可扫读
shots.textZone: 顶部四枚图标各配一行短标签，中部左侧主标题带与右侧拉丁 kicker 位

shots.intent: 整块铺开后让宠物仰躺舒展，用可见的可用面积回应买大还是买小的犹豫
shots.textZone: 右上主标题带与其下一行适用短标签位

shots.intent: 用一捧可回弹的蓬松填充把内部结构摆到镜头前，以实物代替口头舒适承诺
shots.textZone: 左上主标题带与其下一行副标题位，右上拉丁 kicker 位

shots.intent: 两块同光同裁的圆角面板并置正反两面质地，把一垫两用讲成看得见的差异
shots.textZone: 两块面板各配一行面别标签与一行短说明位，顶部主标题带

shots.intent: 侧剖边缘配一枚硬币做真实比例尺，让厚度不靠形容词成立
shots.textZone: 上部主标题带与一行短说明位

shots.intent: 正上方平铺多款花色同名次排列，让买家自己挑图案而不必问客服

shots.intent: 把源图混着款号与会员贴片的参数区换成干净的字段卡，用可核对的信息消除最后顾虑

shots.intent: 四格平铺与一张端坐大图构成实拍带，证明花色与铺开状态与详情页一致

shots.intent: 收口用一景一微距加竖排主张与一个低摩擦按钮收尾，替换源图的会员二维码贴片
shots.textZone: 右上竖排主标题位、下格下方一行短说明位、右下圆角胶囊按钮位

style.backgroundSystem: flat warm off-white panels #F7F4EF alternating with one muted lavender-grey gradient sweep #C6BECB, joined by real sunlit home screens on a pale oak plank floor #D8BC9A; one background treatment per screen, clean seamless white #FFFFFF reserved only for the filling close-up, variant grid and spec card, never a fourth background language
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight 2px line pictograms in #2D2D2D with one small solid dot in #F2733B, flat and no 3D, plus a recurring three-bar orange rule glyph and one wide low wave divider in #F2733B as the only section ornaments
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused window daylight from the left at 5200K filtered by a sheer curtain, mixed with an even 5500K studio fill; low contrast, gentle falloff, matte controlled highlights with no specular blowout, always a real contact shadow so a soft textile reads under its own weight and never floats
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft pastel pet-textile ecommerce detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm off-white panel #F7F4EF, muted lavender-grey gradient sweep #C6BECB, pale oak plank floor #D8BC9A, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D and one warm orange accent #F2733B; warm daylight tone; modern geometric sans-serif for Chinese and Latin with one headline weight per screen, headline 28-42pt paired with a short orange underline bar, a letter-spaced Latin kicker 11-13pt in #9A9A9A at most once per screen, all copy as 「」 placeholders; background system alternating flat warm off-white panels with one muted lavender-grey sweep plus real sunlit home screens on pale oak, one treatment per screen, clean white #FFFFFF reserved for the filling close-up, variant grid and spec card; soft diffused window daylight from the left at 5200K with an even 5500K studio fill, low contrast, matte controlled highlights and always a real contact shadow under the textile; surfaces of pale oak plank floor, matte off-white counter and lavender-grey sweep with plush pile kept readable as depth and layering; infographic components limited to thin single-weight 2px line pictograms with one orange dot, a recurring three-bar orange rule glyph and one wide low wave divider as the only section ornaments, 16px rounded corners wherever a photo card is used; the textile held at constant folded thickness and pile depth across screens, grounded by its own contact shadow, never floating; any animal cropped or turned away so no individual identity reads; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no glossy 3D icons or sparkle effects, no QR codes or store badges.
noDrift: no glossy 3D icons, sparkle, steam or snowflake effects
no QR codes, membership patches or store promotion overlays
no invented loft, weight, thickness or size-count values
style.presentationRules: the textile keeps a constant folded thickness, pile depth and cut size across every screen; shown laid flat, rolled, folded edge-on or in hand so its two faces read distinctly; photo card corners fixed at 16px; the product always grounded by its own contact shadow; any animal appears cropped or turned away so no individual identity reads
style.surfaceSystem: pale oak plank floor with visible grain, matte warm off-white counter, muted lavender-grey seamless sweep; plush pile always readable as depth and layering, never flattened, never plastic-smoothed
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for both Chinese and Latin, one headline weight per screen; Chinese headline 28-42pt paired with a short orange underline bar, a letter-spaced Latin kicker 11-13pt in #9A9A9A used at most once per screen, hairline divider rules, all rendered copy carried as 「」 placeholders
